Rice: the pile is about 150 px wide by 230 px tall, or roughly 8.5 cm by 13 cm. It is an irregular mound, so the footprint is about 70 cm² at a height of about 2.5 cm. That is around 120 cm³ of loosely packed cooked rice at roughly 0.75 g/cm³, so about 90–100 g. I'll call it 110 g.

Meat: there are two pieces.
- The first is about 120 px by 100 px, or roughly 6.5 cm by 5.5 cm. At about 1.5 cm thick that is roughly 40 g.
- The second is a thinner, folded slice of about 130 px by 150 px. I estimate it at about 45 g.
- Together that is about 85 g.

I don't see any visible sauce or oil, so I'm not adding a separate item for it.
